author: Yvonne Halsey
content: We hired some soft play equipment for a join 1-year old party (with nine babies) and all babies and parents couldn't have been happier with the experience. The set up and drop off was a dream to arrange, the equipment was fabulous and the pick up was swift (as was the return deposit).  Thank you Zara and the Dancing cubs team!!  We will remember you for future parties and definitely recommend them!
